trans-unit.source: <Suzu>, lots of people in the Ninja Village have tough names.
trans-unit.target: <Suzu>, lots of people in the Ninja Village have tough names.

trans-unit.source: Well, the names there are just so different from everywhere else.

trans-unit.source: That is a tradition in our village.

trans-unit.source: But it's not normal! I mean, what's the chief's name? “Rambo,” or something?
trans-unit.target: But it's not normal! I mean, what's the chief's name? “Rambo,” or something?
